sources.observation: As viewed 2026-10-21, both issue #1195 and PR #1240 are open. The issue reports DWG-read 3DSOLID/REGION records silently omitted by DXF writing. The nine-commit PR describes support for Region, CadBody, Solid3D and its commit summaries include DwgObjectWriter modeler-geometry/ACIS serialization, version checks, wireframes, silhouettes, GUID metadata, and warnings for unsupported binary data. The PR depends on #1174.

sources.planDisposition: Do not treat the feature branch as released capability. Test DWG read, DXF write, DWG write, actual target version, and per-handle disposition as separate route cells after pinning base/head SHAs.
